name: Taverna da Guzzi
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Taverna da Guzzi in Tirol** Discover authentic Italian cuisine in the heart of the Alps! Our cozy tavern in **Tirol** invites you to savor traditional dishes with a touch of Mediterranean flair. From handmade pasta to crispy *bruschetta*, every bite is a taste of Italy—even when you're surrounded by snow-capped peaks. **Why visit us?** ✔ **Fresh & seasonal** – Ingredients straight from the market, prepared with care. ✔ **Warm & inviting** – A rustic atmosphere where locals and travelers alike unwind. ✔ **Perfect for all** – Whether you're craving a light *antipasto* or a hearty *pizza*, we’ve got you covered. **Must-try dishes:** 🍝 **Spaghetti alla Carbonara** – Classic Roman pasta with creamy egg and pancetta. 🍕 **Taverna Pizza** – Wood-fired, topped with fresh mozzarella and sun-ripened tomatoes. 🍷 **House wine** – A selection of Italian wines to complement your meal. **Location:** Nestled near **Innsbruck**, our tavern is the ideal stop after a day of hiking in the **Zillertal** or exploring the charming streets of **Hall in Tirol**. Just a short drive from the **Ötztal** and **Pitztal**, we’re your home away from home. **Opening hours:** 🕒 **Monday–Friday:** 11:30 AM – 10:00 PM 🕒 **Saturday–Sunday:** 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM **Reservations recommended** – Especially for weekends and special occasions. **Come taste Italy in Tirol!** 🇮🇹❄️ --- *Visit our website | Follow us on Facebook | Instagram*
